scientific_scope: operator qualification only; no population, flare, CME or coronal-helicity claim

velocity_operator.reason_wrapper_not_used: core operator is frozen directly to avoid wrapper-level unit/API ambiguity
velocity_operator.cadence_comparison: 24-minute centered estimate versus arithmetic mean of the adjacent left/right 12-minute estimates

helicity_flux_operator.quantity: relative magnetic helicity injection rate across the photospheric plane
helicity_flux_operator.formula: dH/dt = 2 integral[(Ap dot Bh) v_perp_n - (Ap dot v_perp_h) Bn] dS
helicity_flux_operator.reference_field: potential field matching observed Br on the analysis plane
helicity_flux_operator.vector_potential_gauge: planar Coulomb gauge Ap.n=0; div_h Ap=0
helicity_flux_operator.Ap_solver: open-plane Green-kernel convolution by zero-padded FFT

boundary_and_mask.crop: union high-confidence bitmap bounding box across three frames plus 24-pixel margin; no downsampling
boundary_and_mask.high_confidence_mask: bitmap>=33 AND conf_disambig==90 AND finite Br/Bt/Bp
boundary_and_mask.velocity_solver_masking: no target-based pixel pruning; nonfinite input replaced only outside the union confidence crop by zero after exact mask receipt

real_data_panel.selection: first two north and first two south records in the already-frozen v1.2 TRAIN-only observability panel; no helicity/outcome values used

synthetic_qualification.field: deterministic multi-scale signed Gaussian + sinusoidal vector-field texture transported by constant horizontal translation
